main.description: The authoritative half of a granted flair: this repo's owner (the issuer) grants the flair `def` to `subject`. The record key MUST be '<def>:<subject>' so a verification is a single getRecord; a mismatch between key and fields makes the record invalid, not a grant. DIDs containing characters outside the record-key charset (e.g. percent-encoded did:web forms) cannot be represented in this key; such accounts cannot be granted flairs.

def.description: Record key of the at.tessera.flair.def in this same repo.
